description:
GC/CITIZEN can apply


Requirements:


3 years of experience with Hadoop development and implementation

Good knowledge on Hadoop Architecture and HDFS

Proven understanding with Horton Works Hadoop, HBase, Hive, Pig, and HBase, Sqoop, Apache Spark, Apache Storm

Ability to write MapReduce jobs

Hands on experience in HiveQL

Ability to write Pig Latin scripts

Managing and deploying HBase

Parallel distributed processing based on the MapReduce paradigm with Apache Spark

Experience with Java and shell scripting

Experience with jenkins for Continuous Integration

Good knowledge in back-end programming, specifically Java, JS, Node.js and OOAD

Experience writing to network-based API’s - preferably REST/JSON or XML/SOAP

Analytical and problem solving skills, applied to Big Data domain

Strong experience of deployments and administration in Linux/Unix environments


Skills:


Knowledge with installation and configuring Hadoop based monitoring tools (NagiOS/ Ganglia) is a plus.

Loading from disparate data sets - Familiarity with data loading tools like Flume, Sqoop.

Knowledge of workflow/schedulers like Oozie.

Familiarity with the Java ecosystem and enterprise offerings, 
including debugging and profiling tools (jconsole), logging and 
monitoring tools (log4j, JMX)


 Skill :  Hadoop, HDFS, HBase, Hive, Pig, and HBase, Sqoop, Apache Spark, Apache Storm, OOAD, SOAP


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
